MaterialExpressionComment_34.text:
We are calculating the angle of reflection between the sun and the camera to create specular highlights.
Q: How much does my surface normal align with the angle of perfect reflection? 
The more they align, the brighter the specular highlight should be.

MaterialExpressionComment_39.text: Two sided Material needs to be enabled in order for this to work.

MaterialExpressionComment_42.text:
This MF separates the curved from the flat surfaces.
It checks using DDX and DDY nodes whether the normal vector changes from one pixel to the next.
Curved Surface = 1 (White)
Flat Surface = 0 (Black)
If you want to know more about DDX / DDY:
https://youtu.be/-ynkbsCT2Ic?si=YgmwsEiStZ0klbnl
